# Blitz3D: World

Rendering, updating and clearing the 3D world.


Back to [[Blitz3D]] or the [[Command-Index]].

| Command | Returns | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [ActiveTextures](Blitz3D-World#activetextures) | Int |  |
| [AmbientLight](Blitz3D-World#ambientlight) | None | Sets the color of the light that reaches every surface equally, from every direction. |
| [AntiAlias](Blitz3D-World#antialias) | None | Switches full-screen anti-aliasing, which smooths the jagged edges of triangles, on or off. |
| [CaptureWorld](Blitz3D-World#captureworld) | None | Remembers the position, rotation and scale of every entity, so that [RenderWorld](Blitz3D-World#renderworld) can draw the world between that state and the current one. |
| [ClearWorld](Blitz3D-World#clearworld) | None | Frees entities, brushes and textures in one call, which suits changing from one level to the next. |
| [Dither](Blitz3D-World#dither) | None | Switches dithering for 16 bit color modes on or off, which hides banding in gradients. |
| [HWMultiTex](Blitz3D-World#hwmultitex) | None | Switches multitexturing on or off, so that a triangle with several textures is drawn in one pass or in several. |
| [HWTexUnits](Blitz3D-World#hwtexunits) | Int |  |
| [RenderWorld](Blitz3D-World#renderworld) | None | Draws the whole 3D world into the back buffer, once for every visible camera, inside that camera's viewport. |
| [Stats3D](Blitz3D-World#stats3d) | Float | Gives debugging numbers about the engine. |
| [TrisRendered](Blitz3D-World#trisrendered) | Int |  |
| [UpdateWorld](Blitz3D-World#updateworld) | None | Advances the world by one step: moves animated entities on and applies the collision rules, so entities with a collision type are pushed out of the things they hit. |
| [WBuffer](Blitz3D-World#wbuffer) | None | Switches between a Z buffer and a W buffer for depth sorting. |
| [WireFrame](Blitz3D-World#wireframe) | None | Switches between solid drawing and wireframe drawing, where only the edges of the triangles are shown. |

### ActiveTextures

```blitzbasic
ActiveTextures  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

_Not documented yet._

**Returns:** The number of textures that exist at the moment. Textures count from creation until they are freed with [FreeTexture](Blitz3D-Textures#freetexture) or [ClearWorld](Blitz3D-World#clearworld). Use it to check that a level frees what it loads.

### AmbientLight

```blitzbasic
AmbientLight red#, green#, blue#
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Sets the color of the light that reaches every surface equally, from every direction. With only ambient light, objects look flat because nothing is brighter on one side than another. Lights from [CreateLight](Blitz3D-Lights#createlight) add shading on top of it. The default is 127, 127, 127, a medium gray; 0, 0, 0 leaves unlit parts black.

The example removes the lights from a scene and steps the ambient light from black to white.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
CameraClsColor camera, 30, 30, 40

ball = CreateSphere()
EntityColor ball, 230, 120, 60
PositionEntity ball, -1.4, 0, 5
box = CreateCube()
EntityColor box, 90, 170, 230
PositionEntity box, 1.4, 0, 5
TurnEntity box, 30, 40, 0

For i = 0 To 19
	level = i * 255 / 19
	AmbientLight level, level, level
	RenderWorld
	Flip
Next
```

![AmbientLight](media/world/ambientlight.gif)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `red` | Float | required | Red part, 0 to 255. |
| `green` | Float | required | Green part, 0 to 255. |
| `blue` | Float | required | Blue part, 0 to 255. |

### AntiAlias

```blitzbasic
AntiAlias enable%
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Switches full-screen anti-aliasing, which smooths the jagged edges of triangles, on or off.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enable` | Int | required | True to switch it on, False to switch it off. It is off by default. |

**Differences and known gaps:**

* Accepted and ignored. The picture is drawn the same either way.

### CaptureWorld

```blitzbasic
CaptureWorld
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Remembers the position, rotation and scale of every entity, so that [RenderWorld](Blitz3D-World#renderworld) can draw the world between that state and the current one. Call it once per game logic step, before the entities move. See RenderWorld for an example.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* The original also remembers the alpha and the color of every entity and blends them during a tween. Only the position, rotation and scale are blended here: a fade or color change shows up in the last tween step at once.

### ClearWorld

```blitzbasic
ClearWorld entities%=1, brushes%=1, textures%=1
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Frees entities, brushes and textures in one call, which suits changing from one level to the next. After it, handles of the cleared kind are no longer valid, so do not use them again. Cameras and lights are entities too, so create them again afterwards.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()

; Level one.
camera = CreateCamera()
cube = CreateCube()
tex = CreateTexture(64, 64)
EntityTexture cube, tex

; Level two begins with an empty world.
ClearWorld
camera = CreateCamera()
Text 8, 8, "Textures left: " + ActiveTextures()
Flip
WaitKey
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entities` | Int | `1` | True to free every entity. Defaults to True. |
| `brushes` | Int | `1` | True to free every brush. Defaults to True. |
| `textures` | Int | `1` | True to free every texture. Defaults to True. |

### Dither

```blitzbasic
Dither enable%
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Switches dithering for 16 bit color modes on or off, which hides banding in gradients.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enable` | Int | required | True to dither, False not to. |

**Differences and known gaps:**

* Accepted and ignored: the screen always has 8 bits per color channel.

### HWMultiTex

```blitzbasic
HWMultiTex enable%
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Switches multitexturing on or off, so that a triangle with several textures is drawn in one pass or in several.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enable` | Int | required | True to use multitexturing when the card has it. |

**Differences and known gaps:**

* Accepted and ignored. Textures are always combined in a single pass.

### HWTexUnits

```blitzbasic
HWTexUnits  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

_Not documented yet._

**Returns:** How many textures a triangle can have at once. It is 8 here; on the original it was the number of texture stages that the graphics card had, usually 2 to 8.

### RenderWorld

```blitzbasic
RenderWorld tween#=1
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Draws the whole 3D world into the back buffer, once for every visible camera, inside that camera's viewport. Cameras that are hidden or have a projection mode of 0 are skipped. The 2D drawing commands work on top of the result, so text and shapes drawn after RenderWorld appear in front of the 3D picture. Call [Flip](BlitzBasic-Display#flip) afterwards to show the frame.

The optional tween value is for smooth movement when the game logic runs at a lower rate than the screen. First call [CaptureWorld](Blitz3D-World#captureworld) to remember where everything is, then move the entities to their new places, then draw with a tween from 0 to 1: 0 shows the captured positions, 1 the current ones, and anything between shows the entities part of the way. The example slides a cube across with 20 frames drawn between two positions of the world.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
CameraClsColor camera, 70, 100, 160
light = CreateLight()
RotateEntity light, 40, 30, 0

cube = CreateCube()
EntityColor cube, 240, 170, 60
PositionEntity cube, -2.5, 0, 7
RotateEntity cube, 0, 0, 0

; Remember the old state, then jump to the new one.
CaptureWorld
PositionEntity cube, 2.5, 0, 7
RotateEntity cube, 0, 120, 60

; Draw the steps in between.
For i = 0 To 19
	RenderWorld i / 19.0
	Flip
Next
```

![RenderWorld](media/world/renderworld.gif)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tween` | Float | `1` | How far between the captured state (0) and the current state (1) to draw. Defaults to 1. |

**Differences and known gaps:**

* Entities that are made or hidden after [CaptureWorld](Blitz3D-World#captureworld) are drawn where they are, they do not fade in.

### Stats3D

```blitzbasic
Stats3D type%  ; returns Float
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Gives debugging numbers about the engine. The original help has no entry for this command, and its numbers were only meant for the developers. Index 0 is the number of triangles that the collisions of the last [UpdateWorld](Blitz3D-World#updateworld) looked at.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | Int | required | Which number: 0 to 9. |

**Returns:** The number, or 0 for an index that has no value.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* The original also reports the vertices and triangles of the terrains in indexes 1 and 2. Those are always 0 here.

### TrisRendered

```blitzbasic
TrisRendered  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
cube = CreateCube()
PositionEntity cube, 0, 0, 5
RenderWorld
Text 8, 8, "Triangles: " + TrisRendered()
Flip
WaitKey
```

**Returns:** The number of triangles that the last [RenderWorld](Blitz3D-World#renderworld) drew. It is 0 before the first RenderWorld, and one cube is 12.

### UpdateWorld

```blitzbasic
UpdateWorld elapsed_time#=1
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Advances the world by one step: moves animated entities on and applies the collision rules, so entities with a collision type are pushed out of the things they hit. Call it once per main loop, before [RenderWorld](Blitz3D-World#renderworld). Without it, animations stand still and collisions never happen.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
light = CreateLight()

wall = CreateCube()
PositionEntity wall, 3, 0, 8
EntityType wall, 2
ball = CreateSphere()
PositionEntity ball, -3, 0, 8
EntityType ball, 1
EntityRadius ball, 1
Collisions 1, 2, 2, 2

While Not KeyHit(1)
	MoveEntity ball, 0.05, 0, 0
	UpdateWorld
	RenderWorld
	Flip
Wend
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `elapsed_time` | Float | `1` | Animation speed of the whole world: 1 plays animations at their own speed, 2 at double speed, 0.5 at half. Defaults to 1. |

### WBuffer

```blitzbasic
WBuffer enable%
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Switches between a Z buffer and a W buffer for depth sorting. A W buffer spreads the precision of the depth values more evenly with distance on some graphics cards.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enable` | Int | required | True to use a W buffer. |

**Differences and known gaps:**

* Accepted and ignored. The depth buffer is always the one of the graphics driver.

### WireFrame

```blitzbasic
WireFrame enable%
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Switches between solid drawing and wireframe drawing, where only the edges of the triangles are shown. It is handy to look at how a mesh is built. It affects everything that is drawn afterwards, until it is switched off again.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
CameraClsColor camera, 70, 100, 160
light = CreateLight()
RotateEntity light, 40, 30, 0

ball = CreateSphere(12)
EntityColor ball, 255, 255, 255
PositionEntity ball, 0, 0, 3
TurnEntity ball, 20, 0, 0

WireFrame True
RenderWorld
Flip
WaitKey
```

![WireFrame](media/world/wireframe.png)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enable` | Int | required | True for wireframe, False for solid. |

**Differences and known gaps:**

* On a graphics driver that can not draw lines instead of triangles the call is ignored and the world stays solid.
